post.text: Can you imagine if Biden or Obama started demolishing the Whitehouse? Wtf. https://t.co/aNBG3ApVL4
post.author_description: I review technology from the inside.

description.description: A high-angle shot shows a large excavator demolishing a white, two-story building on what appears to be a government or historical campus, with a much larger white classical building seen in the background. The excavator is tearing into the center of the structure, leaving piles of rubble and debris. Several workers in high-visibility vests are scattered around the dirt site, and a black metal fence with plywood barriers is in the foreground.
